citations.claim: first violation: body overlaps thin wall by 0.222 at step 17
horizontal velocity unchanged from initial despite deep overlap, so no wall impulse was applied
overlap was already 0.09 one step earlier and growing
body was clear of wall two steps before, so this is a gradual sink-in not tunneling jump

counterfactual.change: lowered wall y from 2.9 to 0.5 so the body strikes the flat side face well above the bottom corner instead of grazing the bottom corner; then it bounces (vx flips negative) and no violation occurs

explanation: Body moves horizontally into a thin vertical wall while its centre (y~2.06) is below the wall bottom (y=2.9), i.e. grazing the bottom-left corner. The engine lets the overlap grow from -0.09 (step 16) to -0.222 (step 17) with vx pinned at 8.218 (same as initial), so neither impulse nor positional correction pushes it back in x. Lowering the wall so the same body hits the flat side produces a normal bounce, pointing to missing mishandled corner-region wall contact, not thickness or speed alone.
vision_note: The red ball moves rightward toward the bottom tip of the thin vertical wall while staying just below it. At step 17 it clips into the bottom end of the wall instead of bouncing back in x.
